nodes.text_en: Was this AC newly installed within the last 7 to 30 days?
nodes.text_hi: Kya ye AC pichhle 7 se 30 dino ke andar naya install hua hai?

options.label: No, installed long ago / re-installed after shifting

nodes.text_en: What specific installation issue are you observing?
nodes.text_hi: Installation mein kaunsi specific dikkat dikh rahi hai?

options.label: Unit is visibly tilted or loose on wall
Water leaking from backplate / wall hole
Outdoor unit vibrating heavily against wall
No cooling immediately after technician left

diag_improper_mounting_tilt.probable_cause: Indoor Unit Backplate Installed Reverse Tilted (Preventing Drainage)
diag_improper_mounting_tilt.rag_query: LG AC wall mount tilt water drainage installation standard
diag_improper_mounting_tilt.technician_note: Re-level indoor backplate with spirit level ensuring slight 2-3mm slope towards drain hose side.

diag_installation_gas_valve_closed.probable_cause: Service Valves Not Opened or Flare Nut Not Torqued properly (Gas Leak)
diag_installation_gas_valve_closed.rag_query: LG AC service valve open 2-way 3-way hex key check
diag_installation_gas_valve_closed.technician_note: Check service valve stems are fully open with Allen key. Perform nitrogen bubble test on both flare joints.
